name: ripple-zoom
title: Ripple Zoom
description: Rings of color ripple out and zoom past the camera while the outgoing scene swells away and the incoming scene scales up out of the pattern. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D gradient instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .rpz-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A hypnotic zoom-through between two sections.
Music or event content that wants a pulsing, concentric look.
avoidWhen: A short cut: the ripple needs about three seconds.
author: Remocn
